coverage.fullRunScale: n=20 where applicable, 40k training steps in thesis-facing full runs

subtitle: The project is not just DQN in Pricing Arena. These are the thesis-facing full-ladder outputs for Pricing Arena, Resource Island v1, Auction House, Public Goods, and Labor Market.
title: Five Worlds, Five Learner Architectures

worlds.interpretation: The price-cap result is not a generic DQN anecdote: Q-learning, PPO, independent-DQN, and centralized-critic are all in the table, and the safe claim is budget-dependent. DQN-family learners can recover profits under the cap after enough training while exploitability falls.
worlds.summary: Repeated oligopoly pricing with regulatory mechanisms and exploitability audits.
worlds.title: Pricing Arena

worlds.interpretation: The v1 ladder reverses the earlier v0 non-trade artifact. PPO and centralized-critic activate the trade/reputation channel strongly; DQN and independent-DQN trade less but remain distinct.
worlds.summary: Spatial inventory economy with contested resources, specialization pressure, and unequal trades.
worlds.title: Resource Island v1

worlds.interpretation: The ladder is explicitly not monotone. PPO has low regret in second-price/reserve cases, while centralized-critic is unstable in no-reserve second-price and first-price settings.
worlds.summary: Private-value auctions with first-price, second-price, reserve, clock, and information variants.
worlds.title: Auction House

worlds.interpretation: PPO and centralized-critic nearly stop contributing under baseline and collapse often. DQN-family learners contribute more, and contribution matching creates the clearest discoverable incentive.
worlds.summary: Commons economy with contribution, extraction, regeneration, collapse, and reward institutions.
worlds.title: Public Goods

worlds.interpretation: This is the strongest MARL warning. Centralized-critic has the highest welfare but much weaker stability and truthfulness, so the headline is a metric tradeoff, not simple improvement.
worlds.summary: Worker-report matching market with deferred acceptance, stability, truthfulness, and welfare diagnostics.
worlds.title: Labor Market
